analysis:
Examined all 17 supplied analyses and all replayed source. No concrete regression is independently supported by the available integration evidence. NativeWorkerRuntime.swift:37–45 adds Gemma tensor-parallel dispatch requiring equal shares, a keyed data plane and no speculation, forwarding qualification and the SSD key. Its changed branches forward reservation, cancellation, lane withdrawal, memory-pressure release and shutdown. CapabilityCommandCheck.swift:185 adds tensor-parallel expectations but does not establish serving qualification. Package.swift:79–85 adds a diagnostic dependency; GemmaCheck.swift:494–497 uses explicitly benchmark sealing, not demonstrated production authorization.

The combined change introduces Gemma distributed inference, multi-lane retirement, rank-local KV accounting and resident/SSD prefix reuse. Local analyses describe load agreement, verified artifact reads, sealed collectives, bounded admission and bilateral restore confirmation, but these assertions are not independent proof. Relevant contracts are A-001/A-003 confidentiality, A-004 integrity, A-016/A-017 authorization/qualification, T-010 cancellation, T-028 residual memory, T-041 cache isolation and T-053/T-054 binding/revocation. No supplied evidence demonstrates changed billing, token custody, privileged-helper controls or plaintext response fallback.

Material uncertainty remains: replay omits 122 of 126 reviewed source units. Further review must validate authenticated account scope through Gemma prefix RAM and disk, keyed names/encryption/TTL/purge and kill-switch coverage; reconcile this cluster path with T-041's production SSD-only posture without assuming activation. Validate peer authorization and final-writer revocation, per-lane cancellation/draining, allocation charges and collective bounds against the actual runtime/dependencies. The libs/mlx-swift-lm gitlink delta and ClusterModelFeaturePolicy logprob/lane policy are not replayed and remain material coverage gaps. Reported diagnostic/oracle output must remain distinct from durable qualification. Missing implementation evidence is not evidence of absent controls or safety.
